# Scrum Master PR Review Template

PR Title:  
Author:  
Scrum Master (Reviewer):  
Trello Card Link:  

---

## 1. Checklist Before Review
- [ ] PR is linked to a Trello card  
- [ ] Branch name is descriptive and follows conventions  
- [ ] Relevant tests have been added or updated  
- [ ] Code passes linting and formatting checks  
- [ ] No sensitive data (API keys, passwords, etc.) is exposed  
- [ ] Commit messages are clear and follow conventions  

---

## 2. Review Sections

### Functionality
- [ ] The code meets the requirements of the Trello card  
- [ ] Edge cases and error conditions are handled  

Comments:  

### Readability & Maintainability
- [ ] Code is clear and easy to understand  
- [ ] Variable and function names are meaningful  
- [ ] No unnecessary duplication or complexity  

Comments:  

### Efficiency & Performance
- [ ] No obvious performance issues  
- [ ] Code could not be simplified without losing clarity  

Comments:  

### Security & Safety
- [ ] No security vulnerabilities detected  
- [ ] Proper validation and error handling are in place  

Comments:  

### Suggested Improvements
- [ ] Optional improvements noted  

Comments:  

---

## 3. Final Decision
- [ ] Approve → PR can be merged  
- [ ] Request Changes → Updates required  

Additional Notes:
